summaryForNext: Assess complete: goals 1-4 assessed, goal 5 NOT MET, auth is an UNSOURCED scope addition (goals.md has 5 goals, none about auth - operator added it in-session 2026-09-14; do not treat as authoritative until written into goals.md). Goal 1 PARTIAL: fork's Docker workflow is ACTIVE and image name is owner-templated (ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/od), so publishing needs NO workflow edit - only a v*.*.* tag; new GHCR package defaults PRIVATE so an imagePullSecret is needed. Goal 2 MISSING: zero k8s manifests in repo. Goal 3 MISSING + EXTERNAL BLOCKER: design.know-me.tools resolves 35.238.217.92 via an off-cluster wildcard; gateways are 23.239.29.33/45.56.67.67; needs an explicit A record at a registrar cluster creds cannot touch. Goal 4 ACHIEVABLE: auth can-i confirms cluster-admin patch on argocd Gateway+Certificate, BUT permission != safety - wildcard-know-me-tools-tls is ONE cert shared by 5 live hosts (auth/sso/gate/api/rt) and adding a 6th dnsNames forces a full reissue + HTTP-01 re-challenge across production identity endpoints; a separate Certificate avoids this (risk 6). Goal 5 NOT MET: 49 tables, 425 .prepare(), 320 .exec(), 79 files on SYNCHRONOUS better-sqlite3; storage/daemon-db.ts and project-storage.ts already define the OD_DAEMON_DB/OD_PROJECT_STORAGE seam but have ZERO callers and throw when selected; 116 files write filesystem state under RUNTIME_DATA_DIR that Postgres does not address - three readings (a/b/c) are OPEN for plan to choose, assessor note is explicitly non-binding. AUTH: cluster side is ready (Kratos v26.2.0, allowed_return_urls already covers https://*.know-me.tools so NO Kratos change needed; flint-gate site know-me-tools exists with default_auth kratos_session but zero routes; mint_jwt via claims_enhancement is proven in flint-gate's ssr overlay; strict_agent_governance does NOT block - kratos is provably not agent-reachable). The proposed login app is largely redundant: kratos-selfservice-ui-node already serves login/registration/recovery at auth.know-me.tools/ui; sso-broker only bridges the prometheusags.ai eTLD. THE REAL GAP is consumption not login: daemon has ONE shared OD_API_TOKEN, no owner column on any of 49 tables, no X-Forwarded-User handling; namespace/data-root was evaluated and RULED OUT (process-scoped orchestration, not request-scoped). Edge auth + single-user daemon = shared workspace where every signed-in user sees everyone's projects - must be accepted or funded. Build: guard PASS, typecheck PASS, daemon tests UNKNOWN (timeout at 540s, reproduces prior phase's probe failure - capture a baseline before editing). ADVERSARIAL REVIEW: 2 rounds, both BLOCK, round cap reached, accepted at cap. All findings fixed but the final text (S5 blast-radius, risk 6) was never re-vetted. Both rounds ran isolation_mode=harness-native (weaker) because liter-llm returned HTTP 429 usage_limit_reached; judge claude-sonnet-5 vs producer claude-opus-5 = verified-distinct. WARNINGs carried: (1) shared-cert reissue blast radius is unresolved design choice; (2) upstream images lack this fork's commits; (3) build-review-packet.sh does not embed findings.json into the packet, so prior-round characterizations are not reviewer-verifiable - a real tooling gap worth fixing independently.
